name: Aayush Asawa
player_statement:
A complete player, Aayush Asawa has made a big mark in cricket. With 22 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 16, with an average of 7.23 and a quick strike rate of 86.24. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 2 sixes and 6 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 71.4 overs, taking 37 wickets at an economy rate of 7.05. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
